title: Hide various protocol registration declarations
description:
Several protocols declared their protocol registration and handoff
routines in their header files. Move those to the dissector code and
remove some now-empty headers.

commits_data.message:
Hide various protocol registration declarations

Several protocols declared their protocol registration and handoff
routines in their header files. Move those to the dissector code and
remove some now-empty headers.
